Artist

Pz′ is a recording artist on Banjul Music Group.
Atlanta-born. Model turned rapper.

Papayusupha Goree Njie, known as Pz′, is a rapper and model from Atlanta of Gambian and Senegalese descent, affiliated with the ØWAY collective and Young Vamp Life. He moved to New York at 17, signed with Wilhelmina, and went on to walk for Louis Vuitton at Paris Fashion Week and work with Hedi Slimane.

He started making music in 2023 after moving in with ØWAY’s Tezzus, broke through in 2025 with “HEDIS BUSSIN′”, and followed with “Havana” in January 2026. B4NTB and the debut No Turning Back arrived in June 2026 to a warm response from critics. His delivery is often described as laid-back, ambient and woozy.
